description.narrative: USAIDs Indonesia Clean Energy Development (ICED) program is contributing to the sustainable management of natural resources in Indonesia by addressing the primary barriers to clean energy development in the country. The ICED program is increasing access to energy services to stimulate economic growth and reducing the growth of greenhouse gas emissions from the energy sector by improving clean energy development. Through the ICED program, Tetra Tech is helping USAID to: 1) Improve energy sector policy and coordination; 2) Increase the development of clean energy projects, including energy efficiency and on- and off-grid renewable energy pilot projects, many of which are implemented under grants to private entities and NGOs; 3) Increase institutional capacity and public outreach; 4) Administer grants and provide financial advisory services to encourage the implementation of renewable energy projects and support climate change mitigation activities
